name: Dokodemo Pop'n Music
summary: Dokodemo Pop'n Music is a rhythm game for the Sony PocketStation, included with pop'n music 2 for the PlayStation. Despite the PocketStation's limited hardware, the game allows players to select from multiple songs and play simplified rhythm stages inspired by the main series. Notes scroll across the screen in time with the music, requiring precise button presses to achieve a high score. It serves as a portable adaptation of the Pop'n Music experience, featuring a selection of songs from pop'n music 2.
